name: Credit Card Application and Issuance — Happy Path
description: End-to-end happy path for a personal customer (PER-001) applying for a credit card. Covers PH-023 through PH-028: application submission, automated eligibility and hard credit check (async cross-capability to SVC-012), instant approve decision, card issuance with PCI-safe tokenisation, card activation, and first statement generation. Shows synchronous and async event flows across SVC-003, SVC-001 (same capability direct call), SVC-012 (cross-capability async), and supporting services.

steps.label: Browse card products. Select product. Enter income, employment status, optional requested limit. Review representative APR and pre-contractual info (CCA s56). Consent to hard credit check.
steps.note: ENT-024 CardProduct catalogue rendered to customer. APR prominently displayed (CONC 3.5.3).

steps.label: POST /credit-card-applications
steps.request_body: customer_id, product_id, income_declared, employment_status, requested_limit (optional), hard_credit_check_consent: true

steps.label: Eligibility pre-check: customer exists in SVC-001 (active status). No open bankruptcy/IVA. Product eligibility criteria satisfied. Create ENT-022 CreditCardApplication (status: submitted).
Publish EVT-040 CreditCardApplicationSubmitted
steps.note: SVC-053 consumes for application received notification. SVC-103 audits.

steps.label: 202 Accepted (application_id, status: submitted, message: 'Credit check in progress')
Application received screen. Spinner: 'Checking your eligibility...'
Consume EVT-040 CreditCardApplicationSubmitted. Send application received email/push notification.
GET /customers/{customer_id}
steps.note: Same-capability direct call (CAP-001). Retrieve customer identity data for credit bureau submission: name, address, DOB.

steps.label: 200 Customer data (first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, addresses, nationality)
Publish EVT-041 CreditCheckRequested (check_type: hard, customer_id, income_declared)
steps.note: Cross-capability: CAP-001 → CAP-004. Async only — no synchronous cross-capability calls.

steps.label: Consume EVT-041 CreditCheckRequested

Submit hard search to credit bureau (Experian). Bureau footprint recorded on customer credit file. Retrieve full credit report. Run internal scoring model. Score: 680 — PASS (bank threshold: 620). Derive recommended_credit_limit: £4,500 based on income and score.
Publish EVT-042 CreditCheckCompleted (outcome: pass, credit_risk_band: B, recommended_credit_limit: 4500, cra_used: experian, credit_assessment_reference: UUID)
Consume EVT-042 CreditCheckCompleted
Update ENT-022: store credit_assessment_reference, credit_risk_band: B. Transition status: assessment_complete.

Apply credit policy rules. outcome: pass. income_declared: £32,000. recommended_credit_limit: £4,500. requested_limit: null (not specified). assigned_credit_limit: £4,500. APR: 24.9% (base_apr for credit_risk_band B). Decision: APPROVE. Transition ENT-022 status: approved.
Publish EVT-043 CreditCardApproved (application_id, customer_id, assigned_credit_limit: 4500, apr: 24.9)
Consume EVT-043. Send approval notification: credit limit £4,500, APR 24.9%, card dispatch details.
Push notification + email: Congratulations — credit card approved! Credit limit: £4,500 | APR: 24.9%. Virtual card available shortly in the app.

Issuance workflow triggered by EVT-043 consumption. Create ENT-023 CreditCardAccount (customer_id, credit_limit: 4500, apr: 24.9, status: issued, persistent_debt_flag: false, persistent_debt_months: 0).
POST /cards (generate PAN, issue card_number_token, provision virtual card) [within PCI CDE boundary]
steps.note: PCI DSS: raw PAN generated and tokenised within PCI CDE. SVC-003 receives card_number_token ONLY — no raw PAN returned.

steps.label: 201 { card_number_token: 'tok_4929...', expiry: '12/29', virtual_card_ready: true } [card_number_token only — no PAN in response]
Persist card_number_token on ENT-023. Submit physical card embossing order to card processing platform (dispatch to customer registered address). ENT-023 status remains: issued.
Publish EVT-045 CreditCardIssued (account_id, card_number_token, virtual_card_available: true, physical_card_dispatch_date: today+1)
steps.note: PCI DSS: no raw PAN in payload. card_number_token only.

steps.label: Consume EVT-045. Update Customer product holdings: add ENT-023.account_id to credit card accounts.
Consume EVT-045. Send card issuance notification: virtual card available in app, physical card dispatched.
Push + email: Your virtual card is ready — use it now for online purchases. Physical card arrives in 3–5 business days. Tap to view card in app.
View virtual card in app (secure in-app CDE viewer — card details displayed within PCI-compliant viewer, not cached by app)
steps.note: PCI DSS: virtual card details (masked PAN, expiry) shown only within the app's PCI-scoped secure viewer component.

steps.label: 3–5 business days pass. Customer receives physical card in the post.
Activate card via app (SCA: push notification to device [possession] + PIN/biometric [knowledge/inherence])
POST /credit-card-accounts/{account_id}/activate
Validate SCA session token. Transition ENT-023 status: issued → active. Set activated_at timestamp.
Publish EVT-046 CreditCardActivated (account_id, card_number_token, activation_method: explicit_app)
200 OK (status: active, credit_limit: 4500, first_statement_date: [next statement_date_day])
Card activated! Credit limit: £4,500. Your first statement will be generated on [date].
Consume EVT-046. Send activation confirmation: card active, credit limit, first statement date, link to card settings.
~30 days pass. Customer makes purchases. Statement date reached.

Scheduled job: statement generation for account at statement_date_day. Calculate opening_balance, closing_balance, interest_charged, minimum_payment_due (covers interest + fees + minimum principal), payment_due_date (statement_date + 25 days). Create ENT-025 StatementCycle. Evaluate persistent_debt_months: 0 → no threshold crossed.
Publish EVT-047 StatementGenerated (cycle_id, account_id, statement_date, closing_balance, minimum_payment_due, payment_due_date, persistent_debt_months: 0)
Consume EVT-047. Send statement available notification: closing balance, minimum payment due, payment due date, link to view statement.
Email + push: Your statement is ready. Closing balance: £[X]. Minimum payment: £[Y] due by [date]. Pay now in the app.
View statement and payment history in app
GET /credit-card-accounts/{account_id}/statements?months=1
200 StatementCycle array (cycle_id, statement_date, opening_balance, closing_balance, minimum_payment_due, payment_due_date)
